cards.name: Arador's Bane
cards.text: When Revealed: Starting with the first player, each player must either engage an enemy in the staging area with a higher engagement cost than his threat, or search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Troll or Giant enemy and add it to the staging area. Deal each enemy that engages a player through this effect 2 shadow cards.

cards.name: Abandoned Camp
cards.text:
Guarded. Safe. Immune to player card effects.
Response: After you travel to Abandoned Camp, each player may return 1 card from his discard pile to his hand.

cards.name: No Rest
cards.text: When Revealed: Attach to an exhausted hero, or to a ready hero if there are no exhausted heroes. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero cannot ready and does not collect resources during the resource phase. Discard No Rest if the players travel to a safe location.")

cards.name: Cruel Mountain-troll
cards.text: For each excess point of combat damage dealt by Cruel Mountain-troll (damage that is dealt beyond the remaining hit points of the character damaged by its attack) you must remove 1 progress from each quest card in play.

cards.name: Rugged Country
cards.text: If the current quest is a side quest, Rugged Country gets +2 [threat].
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] for each quest card in play.

cards.name: Secluded Cave
cards.text:
Guarded. Safe. Immune to player card effects.
Response: After you travel to Secluded Cave, each player draws 3 cards.

cards.name: Amarthiúl
cards.text: Response: After an enemy engages a player, give control of Amarthiul to that player.  If Amarthiul leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Barren Moorland
cards.text: While Barren Moorland is in the staging area, it gains: "Forced: When an ally enters play, you must either exhaust it or deal 1 damage to it."  Travel: Deal 1 damage to each exhausted character.

cards.name: Lie Low
cards.text: Forced: At the end of the quest phase, if no progress was placed on Lie Low this round, each enemy gets -20 engagement cost until the end of the round.  Response: After this stage is defeated, choose an enemy in the staging area and shuffle it into the encounter deck.

cards.name: A Miserable Journey
cards.text: When Revealed: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a side quest is discarded. Reveal that side quest and add it to the staging area, if able.
cards.back_text: Reveal 1 additional encounter card during the quest phase unless there is an active location with the safe keyword.

cards.name: Make Camp
cards.text:
Surge.
Characters cannot be healed.  Response: After Make Camp is defeated, each player heals up to 3 damage from a hero he controls.

cards.name: Across the Ettenmoors
cards.text: Rulesheet Card Side 1

cards.name: Weight of Responsibility
cards.text: When Revealed: Reveal 1 encounter card for each quest card in play.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player discards 1 attachment he controls for each quest card in play.

cards.name: Biting Wind
cards.text: When Revealed: Assign X damage among characters committed to the quest. X is the number of characters committed to the quest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Deal 1 damage to the defending character.

cards.name: Patch of Woods
cards.text:
Guarded. Safe. Immune to player card effects.
Response: After you travel to Patch of Woods, each player adds 1 resource to each of his heroes' resource pools.

cards.name: Savage Trollspawn
cards.text: Savage Trollspawn gets +1 [attack] for each damaged character the engaged player controls.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] for each damaged character the defending player controls.

cards.name: Cold from Angmar
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player deals 1 damage to a hero he controls. Then, attach Cold from Angmar to the current quest. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Treat each damaged character's printed text box as if it were blank, except for keywords and Traits.")

cards.name: Into the Ettenmoors
cards.text: Setup: Set aside each of the 3 Across the Ettenmoors side quests and each of the 4 locations with the safe keyword. Reveal 1 of those side quests at random and 1 of those safe locations at random, adding them to the staging area with the safe location guarded by the side quest. Search the encounter deck for 1 copy of Savage Trollspawn per player and add them to the staging area. Shuffle the remaining side quests and safe locations back into the encounter deck. The first player gains control of Amarthiul.
cards.back_text: Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, if there are no encounter side quests in play, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a side quest is discarded, and add it to the staging area.  Forced: When a side quest is defeated, place progress tokens on Into the Ettenmoors equal to that side quest's quest points.

cards.name: Coldfell Giant
cards.text: Forced: After Coldfell Giant engages you, deal 1 damage to 3 different characters you control.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If the defending character has at least 1 damage token on it, attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one.

cards.name: Forage for Food
cards.text: Forced: After 1 or more resources are spent from a hero's resource pool, deal 1 damage to that hero.  Response: After this stage is defeated, heal 1 damage from each hero.

cards.name: Freezing Blast
cards.text:
Doomed 2.
When Revealed: Remove each damaged character from the quest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] for each damaged character the defending player controls.

cards.name: The Hoarwell
cards.text:
Guarded. Safe. Immune to player card effects.
Response: After you travel to The Hoarwell, heal 1 damage from each character in play.

cards.name: Goblin Pursuer
cards.text: Damaged characters cannot be declared as attackers or defenders against Goblin Pursuer.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+3 [attack] instead if this attack is undefended).

cards.name: Troll-fells
cards.text: While Troll-fells is the active location, Weather cards gain doomed 1.  When Revealed: If Troll-fells is not revealed guarding a safe location, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a location with the safe keyword and attach it to Troll-fells, guarded. Shuffle the encounter deck.

cards.name: Scavenge for Supplies
cards.text: The cost to play each player card is increased by 1.  Forced: When this stage is defeated, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Troll enemy and put it into play engaged with the player with the highest threat. Each player may play a card from his hand, at no cost.

cards.name: Journey's End
cards.text: When Revealed: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a side quest is discarded. Reveal that side quest and add it to the staging area, if able.
cards.back_text: Each damaged character gets -2 [willpower] unless there is an active location with the safe keyword.  If the players defeat this stage, they have escaped the Ettenmoors with their lives, and win the game.

cards.name: Shrouded Hills
cards.text:
X is the number of quest cards in play.
While there is only 1 quest card in play, Shrouded Hills gains surge.

cards.name: Ruthless Hill-troll
cards.text: Ruthless Hill-troll gets +2 [attack] and +2 [defense] while it has 3 or more damage on it.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Shuffle 1 location with the safe keyword (but not its attached encounter) back into the encounter deck.

cards.name: Lost in the Wilderness
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player places all cards in his hand facedown underneath Lost in the Wilderness.  Forced: When Lost in the Wilderness is defeated, return each card underneath to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Pressing Needs
cards.text:
Doomed 2.
When Revealed: Either search the encounter deck and discard pile for an encounter side quest and reveal it, or choose a different quest card in play to be the current quest until the end of the phase. Shuffle the encounter deck.
